description: Pi's own default active built-in tool names. Neither language owns this list: the Python constant PI_DEFAULT_ACTIVE_BUILTINS (agenta/sdk/agents/pi_builtins.py) and the TypeScript PI_DEFAULT_ACTIVE_BUILTINS (services/runner/src/engines/sandbox_agent/run-plan.ts) are two implementations of this one pinned contract. The shipped default agent template grants exactly these, so the two must not drift.
